story.title: Every viral clip has a
story.description: This is the journey where an idea, a goal, and a moment meet, so your existing campaign videos get seen, heard, and talked about by more people

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: A golden moment, buried
chapters.text: A full recording has just come to an end. Somewhere in it are the best moments, waiting to be captured, whether from the recording as a whole or from the parts that never got clipped to be remembered and slowly sank among thousands of other seconds

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: Clippers and creators pick it up
chapters.text: Nothing that enters Collaclips is simply left to pass by. Clippers and creators follow every second, pause at the most striking point, and then pick up that valuable moment to share it with more people

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: Cut and polished
chapters.text: That moment is stitched together in a short form, with text and a hook that captivates from the very first second. In the hands of clippers and creators, one small clip can keep moving, get replayed, and spark conversations in new spaces

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: Approved together
chapters.text: Every clip is reviewed and aligned with the existing notes and brief. Creators stay in control, clippers' work is valued, and the collaboration runs smoothly

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: It spreads everywhere
chapters.text: The clip breaks through the timelines of TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Viewers who never knew about it before now stop by, react, and then look for what comes next. And everyone involved can ultimately get what they set out to achieve and wanted

story.closing: One small moment, a big reach. That's what we help make happen

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.description: Can't find your answer? Reach out through the contact options below.

items.a: Collaclips is a platform that connects brands with creators and clippers. Each party has a clear role and supports the others, ensuring that communication goals are met, creative control is maintained, and each role's contribution is measurable.
Choose your role as a creator or clipper, click the available button to join the campaign group, then follow the instructions inside. We'll help you from the very first step.

items.q: What kind of material can be clipped?
items.a: Long videos such as podcasts, live streams, tutorials, and educational content that creators share through Collaclips.
Not necessarily. What matters is that you can spot interesting moments and know the basics of video editing. You can start with short source material and grow from there.

items.q: Do creators lose control of their content?
items.a: No. Creators choose which material to share and approve every clip before it goes live.

items.q: How do creators make sure the clips turn out right?
items.a: Every clip is sent to the creator for review. A clip only goes live once the creator approves it.
Clips are made in a vertical format that suits TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

You can choose any ongoing campaign as long as its budget allocation is still available. Once a clip reaches the agreed target and is verified, payment is sent directly to the recipient's wallet or bank account.
